message: 学名ロロットベアー

name: Lolotte
message: 「Heeey, Mr. Demon.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, Lolo-chan! What's the big idea calling them over on purpose!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's the exact opposite.」

name: Synn
message: 「The opposite?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「To avoid bears, it's best to make loud noises while walking. Bears are scared of humans, so if they know a human is approaching, they'll naturally run away.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ooh. That actually sounds pretty legit. Guess guidebooks can be useful after all.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It was on 'Unprecedented Animals' yesterday.」

name: Synn
message: 「Demons aren't bears, though.」

name: Synn
message: 「M-M-Mmh!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What's up, Synn?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ah... I feel something...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「There's a strange presence. Could it be a bear?」
Perhaps thanks to their special training, everyone has become able to sense magical energy too.

name: Synn
message: 「Everyone, be quiet.」
As they approached the direction of the magical presence.

name: Arden
message: 「Guooooh~. Gaaguuu~. Buooooh~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Just as I predicted, this is a bear.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Indeed... That growl doesn't sound human at all...」

name: Synn
message: 「What should we do? I wonder if Spirit Arts even work on bears?」

name: Arden
message: 「Gaaaaah. Guuuu. Goooooh.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's coming from the gazebo.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Shouldn't we shout loudly right now to kindly inform it of our approach?」

name: Synn
message: 「But... do bears that emit magical energy even exist?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Guess we've got no choice but to go take a look?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「'Earth. A blue planet teeming with diverse forms of life. Among them are countless creatures still unknown to us'」
Leaving Lolotte behind as she drifted off into some distant world, we approached the gazebo.

name: Lolotte
message: 「'Now, let us embark on a journey of exploration driven by intellectual curiosity. Featured on today's Unprecedented Animals is a bear that uses magic'」
We peered inside the gazebo, which was thick with the presence of magic.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Let's name it the Lolotte Bear, after its discoverer.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...No, I'm pretty sure this one already has a name.」
A large man was sleeping alone.

name: Arden
message: 「Gogaaaa. Fuguouuu. Gogoooo.」
It was a tremendous snore.

name: Synn
message: 「...A Demon, maybe?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Looks that way, yeah. Doesn't seem dangerous at all, though.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「When I appear on the show, I'll let you come on with me too, President and Treasurer, so please let me have the naming rights.」

name: Synn
message: 「Right. If he were here for the same reason as those other Demons, there's no way he'd be fast asleep like this.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What should we do? Wake him up for now?」

name: Synn
message: 「Please wake up. You'll catch a cold sleeping in a place like this.」

name: Arden
message: 「Mgh... mgh...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Everyone, I was the one who discovered that bear, you know.」

name: Arden
message: 「Nnh... nnh?」
With a snap, the large man opened his eyes.

name: Lolotte
message: 「President, Treasurer! This person isn't a bear!」

name: Synn
message: 「We've known that for a while now.」

name: Arden
message: 「Mmph... *yaaawn*. Slept like a log.」

name: Arden
message: 「Wait, it's pitch black out!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Um, why were you sleeping in a place like this?」

name: Arden
message: 「It's already night!」

name: Arden
message: 「Damn it. They got me again! Putting a brilliant mind like me to sleep just to slip past! What utterly cowardly, despicable, base, vicious, cunning bastards!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Um... what is this bear-man so angry about?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sounds like his enemies tricked him and put him to sleep.」

name: Synn
message: 「How despicable! What are the names of those people?」

name: Arden
message: 「Right?! You guys think they're despicable too, don't ya? Of course you do--anybody would think those guys are despicable!」

name: Arden
message: 「They're a bunch of perverts who gang up on helpless little girls to make 'em prey to their twisted lusts!」

name: Synn
message: 「To think a group like that is lurking in the academy... I'm shocked.」

name: Arden
message: 「Fuhahahaha! Don't worry, bro. Leave it to the strongest, most invincible me! I'll beat that wicked, heinous Student Council to an absolute pulp!」

name: Synn
message: 「The Student Council?」

name: Arden
message: 「Damn you, Student Council! The next time we meet will be the end of yoooooooou!」
As the giant man roared with a voice that shook the heavens, magic power erupted from him, blowing the roof off the gazebo and bathing the surroundings in golden light.
The dazzling light shot straight upward, rising into the night like the spire of a grand cathedral.

name: Synn
message: 「What incredible magic power!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Th-This is even stronger than Pasta!」
The air is thick with magic power, vibrating intensely.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Could Mr. Lolotte Bear be one of the Seven Demon Generals?」

name: Synn
message: 「Wait... is this guy Bylous?」

name: Arden
message: 「I'll get a good night's sleep tonight! Tomorrow at noon will be the end of 'em!」
Incredible power.
Still... he doesn't seem very bright. This guy.

name: Arden
message: 「If they don't show up, I'll smash every single building on these grounds to rubble! That way they won't be able to stay hidden!」

name: Arden
message: 「I'm on a roll! So clever! Gahahahahahahaha!」
Letting out a hearty laugh, the giant man ran off.

name: Synn
message: 「Hrm. What overwhelming intensity.」
The waves of magic power thin out and gradually fade away.

name: Nanaka
message: 「He completely forgot about us, didn't he. That guy.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「He's an idiot.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Definitely an idiot.」

name: Synn
message: 「Tomorrow at noon... Luckily, it looks like exams will be over by then.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「We have to fight that thing right after exams wipe us out? Ugh, no thanks.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It'll be fine. Fill in the answers you know, then guess the remaining multiple-choice questions, and you'll have plenty of time left to recharge your energy.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You mean sleep?!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Not sleeping. Recharging your energy.」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, this is going to be troublesome...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「He is an idiot, so it will be fine.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「He may be an idiot, sure, but we can't underestimate his strength. It'll be a huge mess if he smashes up school buildings, and I doubt he'll hold back while fighting.」

name: Synn
message: 「If possible, I'd like to fight him in an open area, though.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「So the Treasurer will act as a decoy and lure him out, then.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Why me?!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Well, because you are the President's childhood friend, Treasurer.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「The person who proposed the plan should take the lead and put themselves in danger!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I just noticed this, actually, but we don't really come around this area on patrol, do we?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You're just ignoring me?! We ended up here while tracking the big guy's presence!」

name: Synn
message: 「...Someone's there.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huh?」
Azel is surrounded by those cat-eared Demons!

name: Lolotte
message: 「Let's help her!」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Wait, the President already bolted right in!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn!」

name: Synn
message: 「Get away from Azel!」
Reacting to my voice, the Demons backed away from Azel and formed ranks to confront me.

name: Cat Demon
message: 「Meow!」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel, are you okay?」

name: Azel
message: 「...No problem.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn! What's the big idea running off on your own!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mr. President, more haste, less speed, you know.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Makes no sense.」

name: Synn
message: 「Transform--」
At the exact moment I was about to transform.

name: Cat Demon
message: 「Meow!」
Along with a shout from the one who looked like their captain, the demons vanished into the darkness of the night.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Did they... retreat?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「They must have been terrified of us.」

name: Synn
message: 「But... it didn't feel like they ran away out of fear...」
Were they ordered by someone not to fight?

name: Nanaka
message: 「Maybe they actually listened when you asked them not to rampage inside the academy, Synn?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Then what about that Mr. Lolotte Bear from earlier? He was clearly targeting us, though.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Maybe they called him in as backup or something?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, anyway, I'm just glad nothing happened to Azel.」

name: Synn
message: 「What were you doing out at this hour?」
My voice sharpened before I knew it.
Even though she said goodnight, she was still out wandering around.

name: Azel
message: 「There was an unreturned book in the dorm.」
For some reason, the calm way she said it annoyed me just a little.

name: Synn
message: 「Couldn't that have waited until after the exams?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn, Azel's safe and sound, so you don't have to get so mad.」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm not mad.」

name: Azel
message: 「I hear the library is closed from tomorrow until the 25th for book sorting.」

name: Synn
message: 「So you came to return them?」

name: Azel
message: 「That's right.」
Calm down. Azel is safe. What she's saying makes sense.

name: Synn
message: 「...Melilot-san is scary, after all.」

name: Azel
message: 「Not scary.」

name: Synn
message: 「If you return them properly, sure. Still.」

name: Synn
message: 「You could have just called someone from the Student Council.」

name: Azel
message: 「I don't have a cell phone.」

name: Synn
message: 「Buy a cell phone at least.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Not very convincing coming from you, Synn, since you don't have one either.」
